title: Norwegian Nutty Omelette
description: A delicious and easy-to-make omelette inspired by Norwegian cuisine, featuring a nutty twist. Perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add a tiny amount of oil.
Once the pan is hot, pour in the egg mixture and let it cook for about 30 seconds.
Sprinkle the nutmeg and dried dill weed over the eggs and gently fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another 30 seconds and then use a spatula to carefully flip the omelette over.
Cook for another 30 seconds and then slide the omelette onto a plate.
